blocks.text: Latest update 10:29 p.m., Nov. 15, 2026 MAKATI CITY, Philippines — An earthquake with a magnitude estimated at 5.8 has struck southern Philippines around 9:41 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. According to an advisory from the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), the temblor had a depth of 10 km and was located off General Luna in Surigao del Norte. Aftershocks are expected, Phivolcs noted in its bulletin. The shaking, which was tectonic in origin, was felt all the way in Eastern Visayas, at Intensity 3 in the town of Abuyog, Leyte.
